title: Japanese Discourse Structure Analysis Based on Segmented Discourse Representation Theory Using LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.36667v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Discourse parsing based on Segmented Discourse Representation Theory (SDRT) is crucial for capturing the structural dynamics of dialogues. However, most prior research focuses on English, and its effectiveness for Japanese remains unclear owing to the lack of Japanese SDRT corpora. To address this issue, we construct Japanese SDRT corpora by translating existing English SDRT corpora using an LLM. Through a comparative evaluation of prompt-based and fine-tuned LLMs, we show that the models achieve comparable performance between English and Japanese, suggesting the cross-lingual applicability of SDRT-based discourse parsing. In order to investigate why the English and Japanese parsers achieve similar performance, we conduct ablation analyses on discourse markers and contextual inputs. translated_title: 基于大语言模型与分段话语表示理论（SDRT）的日语话语结构分析
translated_abstract: 基于分段话语表示理论的话语解析对于捕捉对话的结构动态至关重要。然而，以往的研究大多集中于英语，由于缺乏日语SDRT语料库，其在日语上的有效性尚不明确。为解决这一问题，我们通过使用大语言模型翻译现有的英语SDRT语料库，构建了日语SDRT语料库。通过对基于提示词的方法和微调方法的大语言模型进行对比评估，我们表明这些模型在英语和日语上取得了相当的性能，这表明基于SDRT的话语解析具有跨语言适用性。为了探究英语和日语解析器为何能达到相似的性能，我们对话语标记词和上下文输入进行了消融分析。结果表明，我们所考察的大多数日语话语标记词影响甚微，且模型的预测在很大程度上依赖于上下文话语信息。
tldr: 本研究利用大语言模型翻译构建了日语SDRT语料库，证明了基于SDRT的话语解析具有跨语言适用性，并发现日语话语标记词影响甚微，模型预测主要依赖上下文话语信息。
en_tdlr: This study constructs Japanese SDRT corpora via LLM-based translation, demonstrating the cross-lingual applicability of SDRT-based discourse parsing, and reveals that Japanese discourse markers have little impact while model predictions rely heavily on contextual discourse information.
